rows.text: tail-jumps (`002DEF20` + 0xC) with 1 in `ecx`, the incoming `ecx` in `edx`, 0 in `r8d` and the incoming `edx` in `r9d`

when `edx` is zero, tail-jumps (`002DF1A0` + 0x18) with 1 in `ecx`, the incoming `ecx` in `edx`, 0 in `r8d` and the incoming `r8d` in `r9d`; otherwise calls `002DF1A0` + 0x2E with 1 in `ecx`, the incoming `ecx` in `edx`, 0 in `r8d`, the incoming `edx` in `r9d` and the incoming `r8d` as the fifth (stack) argument, and returns its result
